Question: I am from dhaka bangladesh. Somedays ago i saw a dream that i am taking biah't from Hazrat moulama ahmed shafi (Damat barakathum) muhtamim of hathazari madrasa of chittagong, bangladesh, Khalifa of shikhul islam hazrat moulana hussain ahmed madani (rahmatullahiali). Still i didn't take biah't form any shaikh. could you please tell me the meaning of this dream. and suggest me shaikh from bangladesh. Answer ID: 31638 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 802/524/H=1432) It is very nice dream. You will be blessed with the boon of following sunnah, in-sha-Allah. It is better for you to have relation of bai’ah with Maulana Ahmad Shafi’i. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
